view.title: CRM
view.description: The real pipeline, stage by stage — drag a card to move it

stageSubtitles.detected: Detected by BEE, not worked yet
stageSubtitles.prioritized: Set by hand by your team

stageHelp.detected: Same as "New" in a traditional CRM. BEE already detected the signal (a funding round, a key hire, a stack change) — nobody on the team has acted on it yet.
stageHelp.ready_to_action: Same as "Qualified" / "Working". The AI already built the argument, channel, and message — it just needs someone to pick it up and act.
stageHelp.prioritized: Unlike the other columns, BEE doesn't fill this one on its own — your team moves cards here by hand to flag "this is what we're tackling first this week." Don't confuse it with Prioritization (Decision Inbox) in the sidebar: that's the automatic AI ranking across the whole pipeline; this is your own short, manual list.
stageHelp.in_progress: Same as "Proposal" / "Negotiation". Someone on the team already reached out — the conversation is underway.
